title: Kitty campaign: Codex Builder staging scope repair
description: Repair the verified Builder scope-monitor mismatch that kills the existing Codex adapter for its own runner-owned staging files.

packets.title: Recognize Codex adapter staging as runner residue
packets.objective: One mechanical Builder reliability fix only. In gateway/builder_scope.py, extend WORKER_STAGING_PREFIXES so every existing scripts/kittybuilder_codex_adapter.py staging file whose repo-relative name starts with .kittybuilder-codex- is treated as expected runner residue. Do not weaken allowed-path matching for any other file. In tests/test_builder_runner.py, add a regression test beside test_worker_staging_residue_is_not_a_scope_violation that runs a worker creating one allowed gateway file plus representative .kittybuilder-codex-* staging files and proves scope_violations is empty. Also prove an unrelated outside.txt remains a violation; reuse or minimally extend the nearby real-violation test rather than broad refactoring. Change nothing else.
acceptance_criteria: Codex adapter .kittybuilder-codex-* staging files are ignored by Builder scope checks as runner-owned residue.
An unrelated out-of-scope file is still reported as a scope violation.
Focused Builder runner tests and Ruff pass.
